reference_angles_rad: TBD requiring operator specification from mechanical stowed pose or operation config
per_axis_tolerance_rad: TBD requiring operator specification before use; not derived from observed bag variation
decision_timestamp: pre-Path anchor, using each joint header stamp and a prospectively frozen freshness limit
decision_rule: all eight named positions finite, fresh and within per-axis tolerance -> fixed_stowed_pose_verified; otherwise abstain
missing_or_stale: abstain; do not infer stowed from last command or one short observation
simulator_equivalent: check all eight simulated arm joints against the same mechanically defined reference and tolerance; no implicit always-stowed assumption
observed_bags: Two short bags show small arm ranges, but the long selected bag shows large motion on all eight axes; neither fixes a safe reference/tolerance
future_schema_change: arm-pose-aware Evaluator requires a new schema version, train-only normalization and new compatibility hash
